releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Reply no longer defaults To yourself after you have already replied
- Editable To field, per-message Reply, and Reply-To header support when present

## Conferences
- Count-only day guests (Adults / Kids) per meal, with multi-meal apply
- Meal totals, overview, print, kitchen counts, and VoS include unnamed day guests
- Named day guests unchanged

## Staff & contacts
- Staff plan people display and Person/Gender contact autofill improvements

## Fixes
- Client-safe household display name import (build)
